name: Wix ADI
tagline: Wix ADI (Artificial Design Intelligence) is Wix's AI website builder that creates a personalised website from a few questions about your business — instantly generating layout, copy, and imagery in the right structure for your industry. It then hands you a fully editable site built on Wix's platform. It's the fastest path to a credible website for small businesses that don't want to start from a blank template.
